findings.description: The regex check was changed from `match()` (prefix match) to `fullmatch()`. This is not mentioned in the commit title, which is only about accepting an empty message.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `retry_if_exception_message(match="timeout")` with an exception whose message is "timeout after 5s". Previously this matched via prefix; with `fullmatch` it no longer matches. Impact: retries that used to happen silently stop happening for existing users whose patterns are not anchored to the full string.
